_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY. Replace every entry with the queries the realm under test
actually issues, transcribed from its card source. The shapes here are
invented placeholders that match no real realm.
Queries are written in the `_federated-search` ENTRY wire grammar: the
type anchor is `item.on`, and field paths inside eq/contains/in/range
carry an `item.` prefix. `${realm}` expands to the realm URL under test.
Every key other than `label` is sent to the endpoint as-is, so `sort` and
`page` work here too, and a filter is passed through whole — see the
predicates in extraQueries below, which is how a run A/Bs adding one to a
query that has none. See lib/workload.ts.
`fieldset` selects which document the searches ask for, and so which code
path the run measures: `item` is card data only, the path a query-backed
field takes; `entries` (the default) is the prerendered renderings a grid
fetches, and costs several times as much for the same filter.
